transfer_actions_dialog_copy_intro: Copies the {count} selected items and the data they depend on into the target workspace. This workspace keeps its data; the two copies evolve independently.
transfer_actions_dialog_move_intro: Moves the {count} selected items and the data they depend on into the target workspace and removes them here. Referenced settings (nodes, suppliers, logistics profiles, …) are copied or merged in the target and stay here too.
transfer_actions_target_hint: Only workspaces where you are an owner or admin and no data transfer is in progress are listed.
transfer_actions_targets_empty: No target workspace available: you need to be an owner or admin of another workspace with no data transfer in progress.
transfer_actions_strategy_rename: Rename (default): saved in the target as “Name (from this workspace)”
transfer_actions_strategy_merge: Merge into the target direction: clusters move under it, store pools are deduplicated, keywords / categories / marketplaces are combined
transfer_actions_preview_stale: The target workspace or conflict strategy changed. Preview again.
transfer_actions_preview_roots: {count} of the selected items belong to this workspace.
transfer_actions_preview_conflicts: Conflicts with existing data in the target ({count})
transfer_actions_preview_no_conflicts: No duplicates or name clashes with the target workspace.
transfer_actions_conflict_merge: Merged into the existing row in the target
transfer_actions_conflict_keep_target: Target kept; this row is skipped
transfer_actions_conflict_rules: Rules: directions with the same name follow the strategy above; seasonal nodes with the same name merge; existing stores and tracked products merge and are skipped; logistics profiles merge when their pricing fields match, otherwise they are renamed; cost parameters keep the target's settings.
transfer_actions_note_scoring: Leads keep their scoring version from this workspace (v{versions}) and are labelled with its origin; the target generates new leads with its own scoring settings on the next run. Scoring settings themselves are not transferred.
transfer_actions_note_leads: With costing scenarios or archive records as roots, the whole product cluster of each lead is included; its direction is copied into the target (renamed or merged per the strategy above) and stays here as well.
transfer_actions_note_quota: About {count} additional eBay Browse calls per day (above the {threshold} warning threshold): incoming stores or merged directions widen the collection filters.
transfer_actions_note_quota_small: About {count} additional eBay Browse calls per day.
transfer_actions_note_no_samples: Shadow validation samples, readiness stats, weight suggestions and accuracy audits are not copied; the target accumulates its own.
transfer_actions_note_readonly: While the transfer runs, selection data in both workspaces is read-only.
transfer_actions_too_large: The copy covers {count} rows, above the {limit}-row limit. Select fewer items and try again.
transfer_actions_error_targets: Could not load target workspaces. Try again.
transfer_actions_tracked_products_intro: Products tracked from store listings, leads or added by hand. Select several to copy or move them to another workspace.
